nodes.description: owner: current owner address of Owned, initialized to msg.sender.
potentialOwner: pending owner address for the two-step ownership transfer in Owned.
balances: mapping(address=>uint256) token balances in StandardToken.
allowed: nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) of spending allowances in StandardToken.
totalSupply: total number of tokens, written in the PoetToken constructor.
creationTime: block timestamp recorded with now in the Token constructor.
icoAllocation: constant address holding the ICO-distributed tokens.
foundationReserve: constant address holding the vesting foundation tokens.
foundationTokens: number of tokens initially allocated to the foundation (32%).
daysInMonth: mapping(uint8=>uint8) number of days per calendar month used by the vesting loop.
Sept1_2017: UNIX timestamp 1504224000 marking the start of reserve unlocking.
reserveDelta: 456 days after Sept1_2017 when the whole reserve is unlocked.
setOwner(address _new): onlyOwner; stores _new in potentialOwner (two-step ownership).
Owned.confirmOwnership(): onlyPotentialOwner; promotes potentialOwner to owner and zeroes potentialOwner.
transfer(address _to,uint256 _value): moves tokens from msg.sender, guarded by balances[_to]+_value > balances[_to].
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint256 _value): moves tokens using allowed[_from][msg.sender].
balanceOf(address _owner): returns balances[_owner].
approve(address _spender,uint256 _value): writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance(address _owner,address _spender): returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
SafeMath.mul(uint a,uint b): multiplication with assert overflow check.
SafeMath.div(uint a,uint b): division with assert(b>0) and remainder check.
SafeMath.sub(uint a,uint b): subtraction with assert(b<=a).
SafeMath.add(uint a,uint b): addition with assert(c>=a).
SafeMath.pow(uint a,uint b): exponentiation with assert(c>=a).
Token(): constructor assigning creationTime = now (timestamp dependency).
transferERC20Token(address tokenAddress): onlyOwner; reads external balanceOf and transfers that balance to owner.
withDecimals(uint number,uint decimals): returns mul(number, pow(10, decimals)).
PoetToken(): sets totalSupply, allocates 32% to foundationReserve and the rest to icoAllocation, fills daysInMonth.
distribute(address investor,uint amount): onlyOwner; calls transferFrom(icoAllocation, investor, amount).
PoetToken.confirmOwnership(): onlyPotentialOwner; reassigns icoAllocation allowance then calls super.confirmOwnership().
PoetToken.allowance(address _owner,address _spender): returns availableReserve() for the foundationReserve/owner pair.
availableReserve(): computes unlocked foundation tokens from now, Sept1_2017, reserveDelta and the daysInMonth loop.
withdrawFromReserve(uint amount): onlyOwner; sets allowed[foundationReserve][owner]=availableReserve() then transferFrom(foundationReserve, owner, amount).
msg.sender: caller identity used for authorization modifiers and for balance/allowance lookups.
block.timestamp (now): miner-influenceable time used for creationTime and the vesting schedule.
balances[_to] + _value overflow guard expression in transfer().
balances[_to] + _value guard plus unchecked decrements of balances[_from] and allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom().
mul(number, pow(10, decimals)) arithmetic performed in withDecimals().
unlockedPercentage += 2 and _days += daysInMonth[month] accumulation loop in availableReserve().
raw subtraction foundationTokens - unlockedTokens in availableReserve().
raw subtraction balanceOf(foundationReserve) - lockedTokens in availableReserve().
Parameter _new of Owned.setOwner: candidate new owner.
Parameter _to of StandardToken.transfer: token receiver.
Parameter _value of StandardToken.transfer: amount to send.
Parameter _from of StandardToken.transferFrom: source account.
Parameter _to of StandardToken.transferFrom: destination account.
Parameter _value of StandardToken.transferFrom: amount to send.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.approve: account receiving the allowance.
Parameter _value of StandardToken.approve: allowance amount.
Parameter _owner of StandardToken.allowance.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.allowance.
Parameter a of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter b of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter tokenAddress of Token.transferERC20Token: arbitrary ERC20 contract to sweep.
Parameter number of Token.withDecimals.
Parameter decimals of Token.withDecimals.
Parameter investor of PoetToken.distribute: ICO token recipient.
Parameter amount of PoetToken.distribute: tokens to distribute.
Parameter amount of PoetToken.withdrawFromReserve: tokens to withdraw.
Parameter _owner of PoetToken.allowance.
Parameter _spender of PoetToken.allowance.
Local c in SafeMath.mul holding the product.
Local daysPassed in availableReserve: days elapsed since Sept1_2017.
Local unlockedPercentage in availableReserve: accumulated unlock percentage.
Local _days in availableReserve: loop day counter.
Local month in availableReserve: month index used with daysInMonth.
Local unlockedTokens in availableReserve: number of unlocked tokens.
Local lockedTokens in availableReserve: number of still-locked tokens.
Local balance in transferERC20Token holding the external token balance.
